body:
The same problem with `Observable`. And only `"strictMetadataEmit": false` helps.

`Error encountered in metadata generated for exported symbol 'Observable':
... Metadata collected contains an error that will be reported at runtime: Only initialized variables and constants can be referenced because the value of this variable is needed by the template compiler.`

Angular: 6.0.0-rc.3
RxJS: 6.0.0-tactical-rc.1

Bumped into this one today as well on the https://github.com/ng-bootstrap/ng-bootstrap, you can see the issue "in action" by:
* cloning `master` of https://github.com/ng-bootstrap/ng-bootstrap
* edit https://github.com/ng-bootstrap/ng-bootstrap/blob/master/tsconfig-aot.json#L22 and flip the flag to `true`
* run 'gulp build'

I can see the evidence of the same work-around being applied across the community, ex.: https://github.com/ngrx/platform/blob/master/modules/store/tsconfig-build.json#L23-L24
